hypothesis: A numeric-value categorical embedding view (including Distance) and distinct short-schedule RealMLP recipe can complement v5; previous default RealMLP used only four rating twins and a long256epoch schedule. This is not a rerun of that rejected configuration.
reference: Frozen v5; no public score used in local parameter or weight selection

hardware_selection.rule: Before any new validation score, one-epoch no-score probe on largest context view. Use2 if it fits2GiB cap; only on allocator OOM try1. Freeze successful ensemble count for both variants and all later fits.

features.raw: Original21 columns; median imputation trained on outer-train; a categorical twin for every original numeric column; vocabulary fitted by model on outer-train only.
features.context: Existing outer-train Distance maps, missing indicator and five audited source-only features plus the same numeric category twins; source label means/teacher probabilities enter as clipped logits. Existing four rating twins are not duplicated.

primary_gate: Exactly two prespecified views. Delta>=.0001 and positive lower conditional bound vs v5; choose highest eligible primary blend AUC. Freeze view before confirmation.
confirmation_gate: Fixed3epochs and chosen view; positive conditional lower bound vs v5
oof_gate: Fixedfivefold; every fold positive and pooled delta>=.0002 with positive conditional lower bound. Reject immediately after a nonpositive fold.
design_reference: Read-only user-provided Kaggle notebook goodpjw2008/s6e10-two-view-gbdt-realmlp-stack-lb-0-96125; selected official RealMLP hyperparameters and numeric-category idea only. Notebook never executed; no provided predictions used. No global train/test counts, vocabularies, or source concatenation adopted. Ensemble8 in reference is reduced by a prespecified hardware-only rule.
source_teacher_clarification: The reference trains a separate original-only RealMLP teacher; it is not weight warm-start pretraining. That new source-teacher view is not used in these two tests. Existing five source features are from our audited original-only LGB teacher/lookups.
limitation: Public recipe is an external prior likely selected on the same competition. All current validation partitions are reused in prior model selection; conditional intervals exclude selection uncertainty. No untouched holdout or guaranteed leaderboard gain claim.
